data.title: Building Numbers to 10
data.description: Practice building numbers from 1 to 7 on a single ten frame to develop early number sense.

challenges.hint: Try placing 2 counters in the top row of your ten frame.
challenges.narration: Let's start by building the number 2 on our ten frame.
challenges.instruction: Put 2 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Count out 3 red counters to fill the spaces.
challenges.narration: Great job! Now, can you build the number 3?
challenges.instruction: Put 3 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Place 4 counters in a row starting from the top left.
challenges.narration: You are doing wonderful. Let's make the number 4 next.
challenges.instruction: Put 4 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Fill the entire top row to make 5!
challenges.narration: Look at that! Can you fill the whole top row to show 5?
challenges.instruction: Put 5 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Fill the top row of 5, then add 1 more in the bottom row.
challenges.narration: Now let's build 6. Remember, 5 is the top row plus one more underneath.
challenges.instruction: Put 6 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Put 5 in the top row and 2 in the bottom row.
challenges.narration: You're getting so good at this. Let's build 7 counters on the frame!
challenges.instruction: Put 7 counters on the ten frame!

challenges.hint: Double check your counters to make sure you have exactly 7 placed.
challenges.narration: For our last challenge, let's build 7 one more time to show how fast you can do it!
challenges.instruction: Put 7 counters on the ten frame!
